intent: Make book-guard openable from the i3 bar the same way screen-locker is: a [book_guard] block shows this month's paper-book pace, and a click opens the book-guard desktop window. Move the shared pins to gatelock 0.9.0 (the new shared morning-session reader) and today's newest stable releases.
